label: A2BC2_tI20_79_c_2a_c-001
title: TlZn$_{2}$Sb$_{2}$ Structure
comments: Space group $I4$ \#79 allows us to make an arbitrary choice for the origin of the $z$-axes, which we used to move the Tl-I atom to the origin.  Our original version of this structure (Hicks, 2019) did not do this correctly.  We now present the correct structure.
